name: Tran Van Quang
roleLong: SAP & ERP · Master Data Governance · Integration · Applied AI
tagline: I work across the SAP platform — ABAP and RAP development, master data governance and integration — then carry the same problems through to data platforms and applied AI. Working towards SAP Solution Architect.
summary: I am an SAP Technical Consultant with 3+ years on SAP S/4HANA. At Laidon Group I deliver the ABAP/RAP backend and the integration layer for SimpleMDG, a master data governance product on SAP BTP, across 10 customer implementations for US and EU clients. Before that, three years at FPT IS gave me the delivery grounding: around 60 custom objects across MM, SD, FI, FM, WM, PP and QM, integration through PI/PO, OData and SAP CI-DS, and performance work with CDS views and AMDP.

Alongside the SAP core I work on the data and AI side — a 300-million-record warehouse, the Microsoft Fabric platform I led at FPT IS, semantic models for BI, and AI delivery behind human review gates. I also build my own products: an ERP-style dropshipping platform, a warehouse visualisation SaaS, and a RAG search system with verified citations.

Where this is heading: depth in SAP and ERP first — the technical range that makes someone genuinely useful on an implementation — and from there towards SAP Solution Architect. The certifications follow that line, and so does the breadth into data engineering and applied AI, because an architect who cannot see past the SAP boundary is only half an architect.
